figurative_meaning_en: Light, vigilant sleep; sleep with awareness
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে কুকুরে ঘুম করে, কোনো শব্দ হলেই জেগে ওঠে।
প্রহরীরা কুকুরে ঘুম করে দায়িত্ব পালন করে।
example_sentences_in_english: He sleeps like a dog, waking up at the slightest noise.
The guards sleep vigilantly, always on alert for danger.
note: The idiom draws from the observed behavior of dogs sleeping lightly while remaining alert to surroundings, a common trait in Bengali folklore and daily life.
